leave_calculation_policies:
Office Timings
For all Employees by default work timings do not start before 9:00 am and cannot be later than 10:00 am.
For Employees working in different timings same will be approved by Upper Management through ERP
For Employees on permanent work from home the same will be marked from ERP. Above rules 1 and 2 are not applicable.
Allowed flexible timings between 9:30 am to 10:00 am from 15 Feb 2023 for all trainees except those in QA team.
Late Coming
An Employee can come half an hour late from his start time only 3 times per month.
4th late coming will result in 0.25 leaves deduction (if 6 hours have been completed by him/her).
4th late coming will result in 0.5 leaves deduction (if only 4 hours have been completed by him/her).
5th late coming will result in 0.25 leaves deduction(if only 6 hours have been completed by him/her)
6th late coming will result in 0. 5 leaves deduction(if only 4 hours have been completed by him/her)
After the 3rd late coming, if the Employee takes approval for late coming from TL/PM/PA then there will be no deductions provided the Employee completes his/her 8 hours for the day. It is compulsory for the TL/PM/PA to enter the reason of why they are approving the same and on approval notification is to be sent to Upper Management. This will not be considered in count for late coming.
If an Employee has worked extra hours he/she can apply for the approval to come late the next day. TL/PM will get an option for approval once extra hours are approved. This will not be considered in count for late coming.
For the second half employees can come between 2PM to 3PM. If any employee will come after 3PM then Late coming cases will be applicable.
Biometric first-in & last out will be counted as In time & out time of the employee.
Forgot to run Hubstaff Tracker
If an Employee forgets to run the hubstaff tracker then he/she can apply for manual hours approval only 3 times in a month. After that it is not allowed and an Employee must complete his/her hours.
The approval will goto IT Admin who will verify and approve/disapprove.
Work from Home Application
Employees can apply for the work from home request. Approval for the same will be provided by the Upper Management.
Office timings will be applicable.
Forgot to run hubstaff tracker cannot be applied on wfh days.
It is mandatory to use Hubstaff & Upwork in case of WFH.
Note: It is mandatory to use Hubstaff in case of WFH even if you are using the Upwork tracker.
Office Event
When there will be any office events like any game, religious event then the IT admin will add the details for that event along with the employees who have attended these events along with the time spent. This time will be automatically approved for all of the employees and an employee can see this approved time through his/her ERP portal.
It is compulsory for employees to switch off tracker during such events.
Extra working hours Application
An Employee can apply for extra hours once his/her biometric 8 hours will be completed.
Extra working hours approval will be sent to upper management & they will compensate with Leave/Pay if approved.
If Leave is approved by Upper Management then the same will get added to balance. Upper Management has the option to approve 0.5 or 1 leave.
In case of WFH employee can apply for extra hours once his/her hubstaff 8 hours will be completed.
Short Leave
Employees can take one short leave(0.25) in a month and this will be deducted from the Employee's leave balance.
If employee has already deduction of 0.25 two times for any case then he can't apply for short leave from ERP.
Sandwich
Any leaves applied on working days and combined with a holiday and a weekend results in treating the weekend as leaves.
Any leaves applied on working days and combined with a weekend in between results in treating the weekend as leaves. Leave on both Friday and subsequent Monday will be counted as 4 leaves.
5+2 Rule: In case leave is taken for the entire work week then weekend at the end of leaves will also be counted as leaves.
One weekend in a year per employee will be waived off from the sandwich policy. The waiver is available for the confirmed employees only.
For leaves equal to or more than 14 days waiver will not be applicable & weekends/public holidays will be considered as leaves. Employees can avail pending waiver later.
Leaves Allotment
At the start of each quarter each Employee will be allotted 4 leaves unless he/she is on notice period.
If an Employee resigns then leaves will be adjusted on a pro rata basis.
If an Employee takes more than 5 leaves in a quarter then leaves will be adjusted on a pro rata basis.
HR needs to add the date of joining for a new Employee and for a trainee who has successfully completed his/her training period. ERP will calculate leaves for that Employee on a pro rata basis.
HR needs to add the employment type of an Employee as Full time/Part time.Once this date is entered through ERP, then the backend will calculate quarter leaves for that employee according to his/her employment type.
A trainee is allotted only 1 leave per month
Employee leaves can be carried forward till the end of year. Trainees cannot forward their leave.
For leaves equal to or more than 4 days final approval will be given by Upper Management in the case of employees and for interns final approval will be from the layer below the PA.
For leave less than 4 days approval will be given by main Reporting head.
Resignation (Will come soon)
An Employee can submit his/her resignation from ERP.
When Upper Management approves this resignation letter then ERP will calculate the last date of that Employee and will calculate the employee's quarter leaves again according to the last date of that Employee.
no leaves are allowed on notice period so any leave taken will result in extension of last date accordingly.
Sales Team Weekend Working Flow
Team lead will apply for “Weekend Rotation” from ERP.
Team lead can add requests for all of the upcoming weekends of the ongoing month for each sales team Employee - one weekend allowed per Employee. Request will mention the weekend that the Employee will be working on and leave day that Employee will take against it. Leave day must fall in the week before the weekend.
After his submission these requests will go to Upper Management for approval.
Once they approve it then leave for the working day will get deducted from the Employee’s leave balance.
In attendance calculation ERP will check if weekend hours are approved for any sales team member and if so will consider these hours in attendance calculation. 4 working hours per day are compulsory to avail the same.
Attendance Calculation
Timesheet hours exceeding biometric hours will not be considered.
9 hours will no longer be monitored nor any deductions will be made based on same.
If an employee completes 6-8 hours then 0.25 leave will be deducted.
If an employee completes 4-6 hours then 0.5 leave will be deducted.
If an employee completes 2-4 hours then 0.75 leave will be deducted.
If an employee completes 0-2 hours then 1 leave will be deducted.
If user has already deduction of 0.25 in same month for two times for any case i.e late in/short hours/short leave then for 3rd time deduction will be 0.5.
Completing monthly hours flexibility
Upper Management can mark above flexibility for some Employees through ERP (case for TL/PM).
For such cases attendance will be calculated the same as for other employees but ERP will also show hours spent by that Employee beyond what was allowed or considered in calculation. Upper Management can approve/disapprove these hours by checking the data.
NOTE:
Leaves which have been disapproved & if an employee does not apply for leave and then stays absent on any date then its leave will be considered as LWP.
All the leave deductions will be deducted from the leave balance of an employee if available else it will be LWP. If there is not enough leave balance then only leave without pay will be considered.
If any employee came before his/her start timing then system will consider office in time according to employee default start time.
Missed Biometric
If any employee missed the biometric he/she can apply for the approval for the same from ERP.
Employees can apply for the missed biometric request on the same day only & it will be allowed to approve/disapprove till next working day from the applied date.
All reporting heads according to hierarchy can approve/disapprove the missed biometric request.
Call/Task From Home
If the employee has to attend client call from home then he/she can apply for the same from ERP. Approval will be given by upper management.
Note: This case is applicable only if employee has left office early as he/she has to attend client call from home & thus completed working hours.
Special Event
HR & upper management can create special event in ERP. Event created by HR will be approved by upper management. Approved events will be shown to employees. Employee has to reach office according to allotted time.
Early Come
TL/PM can apply for early come requests for the team members. Approval will be provided by the upper management. If any team member didn’t reach office according to the selected time then the case will be applicable according to the Late coming cases.
Reporting Head
HR will assign Reporting Head for the employees/trainees. Reporting Head can approve/disapprove applied leave by employees/trainees.
Timesheet
The Upwork record will only be managed through the timesheet only. Once the IT admin will upload the Upwork sheet, the Upwork record will be approved/disapproved accordingly.
Employees can only enter the timesheet for the current day or the previous working day. And on the last working day of the month, employees must fill out the timesheet for that day, and employees cannot fill it out on the first day of the following month.
For Upwork, the timesheet hours will only be included for the day once it is approved.
Appraisal
If an employee takes more days of leave beyond the annual allowance of 16 leaves, their performance appraisal will be deferred by the number of additional leaves taken after reaching the 16-leaves quota.
